Table "PROJECT" {
  "ID" UUID [pk, not null]
  "KEY" string [not null]
  "NAME" string [not null]
  "EMAIL" email [null]
  "GENERATION_STATUS_ID" integer [not null]
  "SECRET_CODE" string [not null]
  "DESCRIPTION" large_string [not null]
  "IS_ACTIVE" boolean [not null, default: '((0))']
  "CREATED_DATE"  datetime [not null, default: '(getdate())']
  "UPDATED_DATE" datetime [not null]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_PROJECT[1] Where:KEY,EMAIL,SECRET_CODE,IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true] Select:KEY,EMAIL
    Query:GET_PROJECT_BY_KEY[1] Where:KEY,IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true]
    Query:GET_PROJECT_INCLUDE_INACTIVE[1] Where:KEY,EMAIL,SECRET_CODE Select:KEY,EMAIL,IS_ACTIVE
    Query:CHECK_PROJECT_NAME[?] Where:KEY,IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true]
    Query:CHECK_SECRET_CODE[?] Where:KEY,EMAIL,SECRET_CODE,IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true]
    Query:COUNT_SECRET_CODE[*] Where:KEY,EMAIL,SECRET_CODE,IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true]
    Query:GET_PROJECT_BY_REQUEST[1] Tables:PROJECT P, PROJECT_REQUEST PR Where:PR.ID Select:P.*, PR.ID REQUEST_ID, PR.STATUS REQUEST_STATUS, PR.EMAIL REQUEST_EMAIL
    Update:UPDATE_PROJECT_DATE Where:KEY[Equals],IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true] Set:UPDATED_DATE[Now]
    Update:UPDATE_PROJECT_DATE_VALUE Where:KEY[Equals],IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true] Set:UPDATED_DATE
    Update:UPDATE_GENERATION_STATUS Where:KEY[Equals],IS_ACTIVE[Equals|true] Set:GENERATION_STATUS_ID,UPDATED_DATE[Now]
  '''
}

Table "GENERATION_ACTIONS" {
  "ID" integer [pk, increment, not null]
  "PROJECT_ID" UUID [not null]

  Note: '''
    Query:GET_ID_BETWEEN[] Where:ID[Between]
    Query:GET_BY_ACTION_ID[1] Tables:GENERATION_ACTIONS GA, PROJECT P Where:GA.ID SELECT: GA.*, P.KEY PROJECT_KEY
    Query:GET_BY_RUN_ID[] Tables:GENERATION_ACTIONS GA, PROJECT P Where:GA.GENERATION_RUN_ID SELECT: GA.*, P.KEY PROJECT_KEY
    Query:GET_BY_PROJECT_KEY[] Tables:GENERATION_ACTIONS GA, PROJECT P Where:P.KEY SELECT: GA.*, P.KEY PROJECT_KEY
    Update:UPDATE_ACTION_STARTED Tables:GENERATION_ACTIONS GA, PROJECT P, GENERATION_STEPS GS Where:P.KEY, GS.NAME, GA.GENERATION_STEP_ID, GA.STEP_PARAMETERS, GENERATION_RUN_ID Set:IS_COMPLETED[false], START_DATE[Now], OUTPUT_MESSAGE
    Update:UPDATE_ACTION_COMPLETED Tables:GENERATION_ACTIONS GA, PROJECT P, GENERATION_STEPS GS Where:P.KEY, GS.NAME, GA.GENERATION_STEP_ID, GA.STEP_PARAMETERS, GENERATION_RUN_ID Set:IS_COMPLETED[true], END_DATE[Now], OUTPUT_MESSAGE, ELAPSED_TIME[ElapsedMilliseconds(START_DATE)]
    Update:COMPLETE_ALL_INCOMPLETE_ACTIONS Where:IS_COMPLETED[Equals|false] Set:IS_COMPLETED[true]

}

Table "PROJECT_REQUEST" {
  "ID" uuid [pk, not null]
  "PROJECT_NAME" string [not null]
  "EMAIL" email [not null]
  "PROMPT" large_string [not null]
  "PROVIDER" string [not null]
  "DOCUMENT_STORAGE_KEY" string [null]
  "DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME" string [null]
  "TOKEN_HASH" string [not null]
  "EXPIRES_AT" datetime [not null]
  "STATUS" PROJECT_REQUEST_STATUS [not null]
  "RESEND_COUNT" integer [not null, default: '((0))']
  "CONFIRMED_AT" datetime [null]
  "PROJECT_ID" uuid [null]
  "CREATED_DATE" datetime [not null, default: '(getdate())']
  "UPDATED_DATE" datetime [null]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_TOKEN_HASH[1] Where:TOKEN_HASH,STATUS[PENDING],EXPIRES_AT[>|Now]
    Query:GET_PENDING_BY_PROJECT_NAME[1] Where:PROJECT_NAME,STATUS[PENDING],EXPIRES_AT[>|Now]
    Query:GET_PENDING_BY_EMAIL[] Where:EMAIL,STATUS[PENDING],EXPIRES_AT[>|Now] Order:CREATED_DATE[Desc]
    Query:GET_PENDING_BY_PROJECT_NAME_AND_EMAIL[1] Where:PROJECT_NAME,EMAIL,STATUS[PENDING],EXPIRES_AT[>|Now]
    Query:CHECK_PROJECT_NAME[?] Where:PROJECT_NAME,STATUS[PENDING],EXPIRES_AT[>|Now]
    Query:GET_REQUEST_WITH_PROJECT[1] Tables:PROJECT_REQUEST PR, PROJECT P Where:PR.ID, PR.STATUS[CONFIRMED] Select:PR.*, P.KEY PROJECT_KEY, P.EMAIL PROJECT_EMAIL, P.IS_ACTIVE PROJECT_IS_ACTIVE
    Query:GET_CONFIRMED_BY_PROJECT[1] Tables:PROJECT_REQUEST PR, PROJECT P Where:P.KEY, PR.STATUS[CONFIRMED] Select:PR.*, P.KEY PROJECT_KEY
    Update:CONFIRM Where:ID,STATUS[PENDING] Set:STATUS[CONFIRMED],CONFIRMED_AT[Now],PROJECT_ID,UPDATED_DATE[Now]
    Update:RESEND Where:ID,STATUS[PENDING] Set:TOKEN_HASH,EXPIRES_AT,RESEND_COUNT[+1],UPDATED_DATE[Now]
    Update:UPDATE_EMAIL Where:ID,STATUS[PENDING] Set:EMAIL,TOKEN_HASH,EXPIRES_AT,UPDATED_DATE[Now]
    Update:UPDATE_DOCUMENT Where:ID,STATUS[PENDING] Set:DOCUMENT_STORAGE_KEY,DOCUMENT_FILE_NAME,UPDATED_DATE[Now]
    Update:CANCEL Where:ID,STATUS[PENDING] Set:STATUS[CANCELLED],UPDATED_DATE[Now]
    Update:EXPIRE_STALE Where:STATUS[PENDING],EXPIRES_AT[<|Now] Set:STATUS[EXPIRED],UPDATED_DATE[Now]
  '''
}

PROJECT_MODULES.DESCRIPTION: Tracks projects, modules, generation runs, and platform catalog data.

PROJECT_MODULES.DBML:
Enum "PAYOUT_STATUS" {
  PENDING [note: "Payout calculated and awaiting approval"]
  APPROVED [note: "Payout approved and ready for processing"]
  PROCESSING [note: "Payout approved and sent to payment provider"]
  PAID [note: "Payout successfully transferred to the seller"]
  FAILED [note: "Payout transfer failed"]
  CANCELLED [note: "Payout cancelled by admin"]
}

Enum "TRANSACTION_TYPE" {
  SALE [note: "Revenue from a sale"]
  REFUND [note: "Deduction due to a customer refund"]
  COMMISSION [note: "Marketplace commission fee"]
  ADJUSTMENT_CREDIT [note: "A manual credit adjustment"]
  ADJUSTMENT_DEBIT [note: "A manual debit adjustment"]
  PAYOUT [note: "A withdrawal of funds by the seller"]
  CHARGEBACK [note: "Chargeback from payment processor"]
}

Enum "ADJUSTMENT_REASON" {
  SHIPPING_FEE [note: "Shipping fee adjustment"]
  MARKETING_BONUS [note: "Bonus for marketing participation"]
  DISPUTE_RESOLUTION [note: "Adjustment from a dispute resolution"]
  CHARGEBACK_REVERSAL [note: "Reversal of chargeback fee"]
  PLATFORM_ERROR [note: "Correction for platform error"]
  OTHER [note: "Other miscellaneous reason"]
}

Enum "COMMISSION_STATUS" {
  PENDING [note: "Commission calculated but not yet applied"]
  APPLIED [note: "Commission applied to seller balance"]
  PAID [note: "Commission included in payout"]
}

Table "PAYOUT_PERIODS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "PERIOD_NAME" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  "START_DATE" DATETIME [not null]
  "END_DATE" DATETIME [not null]
  "IS_CLOSED" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'false']
  "CLOSED_DATE" DATETIME
  "CREATED_DATE" DATETIME [not null]
  
  Note: '''

Enum "PRODUCT_STATUS" {
  DRAFT [note: "Product is being created and not yet visible"]
  PENDING_APPROVAL [note: "Product submitted for review by marketplace admin"]
  ACTIVE [note: "Product is live and available for sale"]
  INACTIVE [note: "Product is not visible on the marketplace"]
  DISCONTINUED [note: "Product is no longer sold"]
}

Table "PRODUCTS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "SELLER_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "BRAND_ID" INTEGER
  "PRIMARY_CATEGORY_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "SKU" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  "NAME" STRING [not null]
  "DESCRIPTION" BIG_STRING
  "PHOTO" BLOB_IMAGE
  "VIDEO" BLOB_VIDEO
  "DATASHEET" BLOB_PDF
  "STATUS" PRODUCT_STATUS [not null, default: 'DRAFT']
  "IS_FEATURED" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'false']
  "CREATED_DATE" DATETIME
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_SKU[1] Where:SKU Select:ID,NAME,STATUS,SELLER_ID,PHOTO,VIDEO,DATASHEET
    Query:GET_ACTIVE_BY_SELLER[P] Where:SELLER_ID,STATUS[ACTIVE] Select:ID,SKU,NAME,STATUS,PHOTO,VIDEO
    Query:SEARCH_PRODUCTS[P] Where:NAME[Contains],STATUS[ACTIVE] Select:ID,SKU,NAME,PHOTO,VIDEO
    Query:GET_PENDING_APPROVAL[P] Where:STATUS[PENDING_APPROVAL] Select:ID,SKU,NAME,SELLER_ID,PHOTO,VIDEO,DATASHEET
    Query:GET_FEATURED[P] Where:IS_FEATURED[true],STATUS[ACTIVE] Select:ID,SKU,NAME,PHOTO,VIDEO
    Query:GET_PRODUCTS_WITH_DETAILS[P] Tables:PRODUCTS P,CATEGORIES C,BRANDS B Where:P.PRIMARY_CATEGORY_ID,C.ID,P.BRAND_ID,B.ID Select:P.ID,P.SKU,P.NAME,P.PHOTO,P.VIDEO,P.DATASHEET,C.NAME CATEGORY_NAME,B.NAME BRAND_NAME,B.LOGO BRAND_LOGO
    Update:APPROVE Where:ID Set:STATUS[ACTIVE]
    Update:REJECT Where:ID Set:STATUS[INACTIVE]
    Update:SET_FEATURED Where:ID Set:IS_FEATURED
    Query:GET_COUNT_BY_STATUS[1] Where:STATUS Select:STATUS,COUNT(*) COUNT
  '''
}

Table "PRODUCT_VARIANTS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "PRODUCT_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "SKU" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  "PRICE" MONEY [not null]
  "STOCK_QUANTITY" INTEGER [not null, default: 0]
  "IS_ACTIVE" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'true']
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_PRODUCT_ID[P] Where:PRODUCT_ID Select:ID,SKU,PRICE,STOCK_QUANTITY,IS_ACTIVE
    Query:GET_ACTIVE_BY_PRODUCT_ID[P] Where:PRODUCT_ID,IS_ACTIVE[true] Select:ID,SKU,PRICE,STOCK_QUANTITY
    Query:GET_LOW_STOCK_VARIANTS[P] Where:STOCK_QUANTITY[<|10],IS_ACTIVE[true] Select:ID,PRODUCT_ID,SKU,STOCK_QUANTITY
    Update:UPDATE_STOCK Where:ID Set:STOCK_QUANTITY
    Update:UPDATE_PRICE Where:ID Set:PRICE
    Update:DEACTIVATE Where:ID Set:IS_ACTIVE[false]
  '''
}

Table "CATEGORIES" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "PARENT_CATEGORY_ID" INTEGER
  "NAME" STRING [not null]
  "SLUG" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  "ICON" BLOB_IMAGE
  "BANNER" BLOB_IMAGE
  "INTRO_VIDEO" BLOB_VIDEO
  "IS_ACTIVE" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'true']
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_ACTIVE[P] Where:IS_ACTIVE[true] Select:ID,NAME,SLUG,ICON,BANNER,INTRO_VIDEO,PARENT_CATEGORY_ID
    Query:GET_SUB_CATEGORIES[P] Where:PARENT_CATEGORY_ID,IS_ACTIVE[true] Select:ID,NAME,SLUG,ICON,BANNER,INTRO_VIDEO
    Query:GET_BY_SLUG[1] Where:SLUG,IS_ACTIVE[true] Select:ID,NAME,ICON,BANNER,INTRO_VIDEO,PARENT_CATEGORY_ID
    Update:DEACTIVATE Where:ID Set:IS_ACTIVE[false]
  '''
}

Table "PRODUCT_CATEGORIES" {
  "PRODUCT_ID" INTEGER [pk]
  "CATEGORY_ID" INTEGER [pk]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_PRODUCT_ID[] Where:PRODUCT_ID Select:CATEGORY_ID
    Query:GET_BY_CATEGORY_ID[P] Where:CATEGORY_ID Select:PRODUCT_ID
    Delete:REMOVE_FROM_CATEGORY Where:PRODUCT_ID,CATEGORY_ID
  '''
}

Table "BRANDS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "NAME" STRING [not null]
  "LOGO" BLOB_IMAGE
  "PHOTO" BLOB_IMAGE
  "BRAND_VIDEO" BLOB_VIDEO
  "CATALOG_PDF" BLOB_PDF
  "IS_ACTIVE" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'true']
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_ACTIVE[P] Where:IS_ACTIVE[true] Select:ID,NAME,LOGO,PHOTO,BRAND_VIDEO,CATALOG_PDF
    Query:SEARCH_BY_NAME[P] Where:NAME[Contains] Select:ID,NAME,LOGO,PHOTO,BRAND_VIDEO,CATALOG_PDF
    Update:DEACTIVATE Where:ID Set:IS_ACTIVE[false]
  '''
}

Table "ATTRIBUTE_DEFINITIONS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "NAME" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  "CODE" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_CODE[1] Where:CODE Select:ID,NAME
  '''
}

Table "ATTRIBUTE_VALUES" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "ATTRIBUTE_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "VALUE" STRING [not null]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_ATTRIBUTE_ID[P] Where:ATTRIBUTE_ID Select:ID,VALUE
  '''
}

Table "PRODUCT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES" {
  "VARIANT_ID" INTEGER [pk]
  "ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_ID" INTEGER [pk]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_VARIANT_ID[] Where:VARIANT_ID Select:ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_ID
    Delete:REMOVE_ATTRIBUTE Where:VARIANT_ID,ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_ID
  '''
}

Ref: "PRODUCTS"."BRAND_ID" > "BRANDS"."ID"
Ref: "PRODUCTS"."PRIMARY_CATEGORY_ID" > "CATEGORIES"."ID"
Ref: "PRODUCT_VARIANTS"."PRODUCT_ID" > "PRODUCTS"."ID"
Ref: "CATEGORIES"."PARENT_CATEGORY_ID" > "CATEGORIES"."ID"
Ref: "PRODUCT_CATEGORIES"."PRODUCT_ID" > "PRODUCTS"."ID"
Ref: "PRODUCT_CATEGORIES"."CATEGORY_ID" > "CATEGORIES"."ID"
Ref: "ATTRIBUTE_VALUES"."ATTRIBUTE_ID" > "ATTRIBUTE_DEFINITIONS"."ID"
Ref: "PRODUCT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES"."VARIANT_ID" > "PRODUCT_VARIANTS"."ID"
Ref: "PRODUCT_VARIANT_ATTRIBUTES"."ATTRIBUTE_VALUE_ID" > "ATTRIBUTE_VALUES"."ID"
PROJECT_MODULES.DESCRIPTION: Manages all aspects of products, including categorization, variants, attributes, and brand information. This module serves as the central source of truth for all product data available on the marketplace.

PROJECT_MODULES.DBML:
Enum "SELLER_STATUS" {
  PENDING_VERIFICATION [note: "New seller, awaiting document verification"]
  ACTIVE [note: "Seller is approved and can sell on the platform"]
  SUSPENDED [note: "Seller's account is temporarily disabled"]
  REJECTED [note: "Seller application was rejected"]
  CLOSED [note: "Seller has closed their account"]
}

Enum "DOCUMENT_TYPE" {
  IDENTITY [note: "National ID or Passport"]
  BUSINESS_REGISTRATION [note: "Official business registration document"]
  TAX_ID [note: "Tax identification document"]
  BANK_STATEMENT [note: "Bank account ownership proof"]
}

Enum "VERIFICATION_STATUS" {
  PENDING [note: "Document uploaded, awaiting review"]
  VERIFIED [note: "Document has been verified"]
  REJECTED [note: "Document was rejected"]
}

Table "SELLERS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "USER_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "COMPANY_NAME" STRING [not null]
  "CONTACT_EMAIL" EMAIL [not null]
  "CONTACT_PHONE" PHONE
  "STATUS" SELLER_STATUS [not null, default: 'PENDING_VERIFICATION']
  "SELLER_TIER_ID" INTEGER
  "JOINED_DATE" DATETIME [not null]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_USER_ID[1] Where:USER_ID Select:ID,COMPANY_NAME,STATUS
    Query:GET_BY_STATUS[P] Where:STATUS Select:ID,COMPANY_NAME,CONTACT_EMAIL,JOINED_DATE
    Query:SEARCH_BY_COMPANY_NAME[P] Where:COMPANY_NAME[Contains] Select:ID,COMPANY_NAME,STATUS
    Update:APPROVE Where:ID Set:STATUS[ACTIVE]
    Update:SUSPEND Where:ID Set:STATUS[SUSPENDED]
    Update:REJECT Where:ID Set:STATUS[REJECTED]
    Update:UPDATE_TIER Where:ID Set:SELLER_TIER_ID
    Query:GET_PENDING_VERIFICATION_COUNT[*] Where:STATUS[PENDING_VERIFICATION]
  '''
}

Table "STORES" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "SELLER_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "NAME" STRING [not null]
  "SLUG" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  "DESCRIPTION" BIG_STRING
  "LOGO_URL" BLOB_IMAGE
  "IS_ACTIVE" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'true']
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_SELLER_ID[1] Where:SELLER_ID Select:ID,NAME,SLUG,IS_ACTIVE
    Query:GET_BY_SLUG[1] Where:SLUG Select:ID,SELLER_ID,NAME
    Update:UPDATE_PROFILE Where:ID Set:NAME,DESCRIPTION,LOGO_URL
    Update:DEACTIVATE Where:ID Set:IS_ACTIVE[false]
  '''
}

Table "SELLER_DOCUMENTS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "SELLER_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "DOCUMENT_TYPE" DOCUMENT_TYPE [not null]
  "FILE_URL" URL [not null]
  "STATUS" VERIFICATION_STATUS [not null, default: 'PENDING']
  "UPLOADED_DATE" DATETIME [not null]
  "REVIEWED_DATE" DATETIME
  "REJECTION_REASON" BIG_STRING
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_SELLER_ID[P] Where:SELLER_ID Select:ID,DOCUMENT_TYPE,STATUS,UPLOADED_DATE
    Query:GET_PENDING_DOCUMENTS[P] Where:STATUS[PENDING] Select:ID,SELLER_ID,DOCUMENT_TYPE,UPLOADED_DATE
    Update:VERIFY Where:ID Set:STATUS[VERIFIED],REVIEWED_DATE[Now]
    Update:REJECT Where:ID Set:STATUS[REJECTED],REVIEWED_DATE[Now],REJECTION_REASON
  '''
}

Table "SELLER_BANK_ACCOUNTS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "SELLER_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "BANK_NAME" STRING [not null]
  "ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME" STRING [not null]
  "IBAN" SHORT_STRING [not null]
  "IS_DEFAULT" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'false']
  "IS_VERIFIED" BOOLEAN [not null, default: 'false']
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_SELLER_ID[P] Where:SELLER_ID Select:ID,BANK_NAME,ACCOUNT_HOLDER_NAME,IBAN,IS_DEFAULT,IS_VERIFIED
    Query:GET_DEFAULT_BY_SELLER_ID[1] Where:SELLER_ID,IS_DEFAULT[true] Select:ID,IBAN,IS_VERIFIED
    Update:SET_AS_DEFAULT Where:SELLER_ID Set:IS_DEFAULT[false]
    Update:SET_DEFAULT_ACCOUNT Where:ID Set:IS_DEFAULT[true]
  '''
}

Table "SELLER_TIERS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "NAME" STRING [not null]
  "MIN_SALES_VOLUME" MONEY
  "BENEFITS_DESCRIPTION" BIG_STRING
  Note: '''
  Query:GET_BY_NAME[1] Where:NAME Select:ID,BENEFITS_DESCRIPTION
'''
}

Table "SELLER_PERFORMANCE_REVIEWS" {
  "ID" INTEGER [pk, increment]
  "SELLER_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "REVIEWER_ID" INTEGER [not null]
  "RATING" SMALL_INTEGER [not null]
  "COMMENT" BIG_STRING
  "REVIEW_DATE" DATETIME [not null]
  Note: '''
    Query:GET_BY_SELLER_ID[P] Where:SELLER_ID Order:REVIEW_DATE[Desc] Select:ID,RATING,COMMENT,REVIEW_DATE
    Query:GET_SELLER_AVERAGE_RATING[1] Where:SELLER_ID Select:AVG(RATING) AVERAGE_RATING,COUNT(*) REVIEW_COUNT
  '''
}

Ref: "STORES"."SELLER_ID" > "SELLERS"."ID"
Ref: "SELLERS"."SELLER_TIER_ID" > "SELLER_TIERS"."ID"
Ref: "SELLER_DOCUMENTS"."SELLER_ID" > "SELLERS"."ID"
Ref: "SELLER_BANK_ACCOUNTS"."SELLER_ID" > "SELLERS"."ID"
Ref: "SELLER_PERFORMANCE_REVIEWS"."SELLER_ID" > "SELLERS"."ID"
